evidence.quote: If you have a school leaving certificate from Morocco, you will need to submit the following documents: overview of your subjects and grades ("Relevé de Notes") of the Baccalauréat
If you hold a degree from a Moroccan university, you will need to submit the following documents: Degree certificate Complete transcript of records, including all courses and results
If you took the "classes préparatoires" you will need to submit your transcript of records of these classes.
A Baccalauréat alone does not allow you to study directly in Germany. It qualifies you for the Studienkolleg (preparatory course) and the "Feststellungsprüfung" (university qualification exam).
Your certificates must be official: official certificates are those bearing a signature and stamp from the issuing institution, a reference to their automatic issuance or a verification code.
Upload all certificates in their entirety in My assist: include the diploma certificate as well as the overview of subjects and grades.
School leaving certificate Submit the certificate that entitles you to start university studies in your home country.
Have you already studied at a university outside Germany? Please submit a complete overview of all subjects and grades (transcript), issued by your university.
Upload your education certificates in their original language, accompanied by a translation into German or English.

We accept translations of certificates from the following sources: persons or institutions authorised to make translations under oath or admissible in court, a department of the issuing school or university authorised to issue such translations.

entries.notes: General uni-assist guidance for applicants with a Moroccan certificate, not a requirement of each university: the university may ask for more, and documents are checked per university. The Baccalauréat certificate and its grade transcript apply to a school leaver; the university transcript applies to anyone who has already studied at a university outside Germany (uni-assist: 'Have you already studied at a university outside Germany?'), the degree certificate only to those who have a degree from a Moroccan university, and the classes préparatoires transcript only to those who took classes préparatoires. The Morocco page says a Baccalauréat alone does not allow studying directly in Germany: it qualifies for the Studienkolleg (preparatory course) and the Feststellungsprüfung (university qualification exam). General uni-assist rules (educational-certificates and translations pages), not tied to one document by a quote, so no item carries a translation flag: certificates must be official, that is bearing a signature and stamp from the issuing institution, a reference to their automatic issuance or a verification code; upload them in the original language with a translation into German or English (not needed if the country also issues the certificate in German or English; exceptions are listed per country, and the Morocco page lists none); translations are accepted from persons or institutions authorised to make translations under oath or admissible in court, or from a department of the issuing school or university authorised to issue such translations, not from standard translation agencies. Attaches to programmes whose application channel is uni-assist or uni-assist VPD, so run it again after the German channel batch (national-de-channel) is promoted.
